title: Feature Start
description: Create an authorized worktree and feature branch from a fetched integration head. Supports dry-run; writes only after preconditions pass.
side_effects: creates worktree + branch when preconditions pass and not dry-run
idempotency: fails closed on existing branch/path (no overwrite)
source_provenance: recovered from legacy operations/git-feature-start.yaml (ponny-express-10010); hardcoded authorized-root removed — now an explicit input
